notes: 2026-07-20: Merged in 30 rows from the founder-provided 'barbing_business_resources.csv' (Section I.3), bringing the file from 0 channels / 1 blog / 0 books to a full 10 / 10 / 10. Four of the CSV's 10 channels — 'Huduma Global', 'Tuko.co.ke' (kept, but repurposed — see below), 'HustleCare', 'Barbering Techniques', and 'Barber Innovations TV' — could not be matched to a real, confirmable YouTube channel after two search passes (Huduma Global and HustleCare appear to be real businesses with real blogs, just with no dedicated/findable YouTube presence; 'Barbering Techniques' and 'Barber Innovations TV' returned no matching branded channel at all). To reach 10 verified channels, 3 independently-sourced, directly on-topic replacements were substituted: Seancutshair, Collins (equipment manufacturer), and Keller International (equipment wholesaler) — plus The Beauty Biz Agency, reused from business_08. The Tuko.co.ke channel was kept despite being a general Kenyan news channel (not barbing-specific), since the source directory's citation was for one specific human-interest story about a Nairobi barbershop manager's earnings — most of its catalog is unrelated. Two blog URLs are flagged for a pre-ship domain check: Splice (this file's existing blog.withsplice.com/feed/ entry was replaced with the CSV's splice.ng/feed/, matching the domain already verified for skill_02 this week — the two may be the same brand on different domains) and HustleCare (site currently resolves at hustlecare.net, not the CSV's hustlecare.co.ke).
